name: prism1
author: ghjob360
tagline: a Vital-style wavetable synth: 8 voices, 3 wavetable oscillators + a sampler, 2 filters, 18 modulators, 32 mod slots, 9 effects
description: Eight voices on both cores of three wavetable oscillators (32 factory tables of 32 frames, unison up to 8 with Vital's stacks, its warps and spectral morphs) and a sample oscillator, through two filters (Vital's eight models, serial or parallel); six envelopes, eight LFOs with drawable shapes and Vital's sync modes, four random LFOs, four macros and a 32-slot modulation matrix with power curves; Vital's nine effects in any order. Assign modulation by picking up a source and turning any knob; the knobs show the modulation's reach and what a voice hears.
credits: after Vital by Matt Tytel (GPL-3.0): its oscillator warps, envelope curves and voice architecture, cut down for the FM-1; built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hugelton Instruments)
